description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractSearchMappingStrategies' which provides helper methods for mapping Adaptable instances to search commands and events within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It appears to be part of a larger system handling JSON-based messaging and search functionalities.

classes.name: AbstractSearchMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for extracting search-related data from Adaptable objects, including selected fields and subscription IDs.

methods.name: selectedFieldsFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the selected JSON fields from an Adaptable's payload, if available.

methods.name: subscriptionIdFrom
methods.description: Extracts the subscription ID from an Adaptable's payload, if present.

methods.name: getFromValue
methods.description: A generic method to fetch a value from an Adaptable's payload based on a JsonFieldDefinition.
